name: Bugaboo Dragonfly adapter for Maxi-Cosi car seat
_partNumberNote: Clek's official list files this row as 'Included with stroller' (no adapter part number to buy). Bugaboo does sell a standalone replacement of the same adapter under SKU 400003001 (also styled 400003MI) for aftermarket purchase, but as a bundled-in-box item it has no purchase part number on Clek's list -> null.
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi footprint. Per Bugaboo's official Dragonfly Maxi-Cosi adapter page (400003001), compatible seats include: Maxi-Cosi Coral XP, Mico Max Plus, Mico, Mico 30; Nuna Pipa RX, Pipa, Pipa Lite, Pipa Lite LX; Bugaboo Turtle Air Shield/Turtle Air/Turtle One by Nuna; Cybex Aton M, Aton 2; and — explicitly — the Clek Liing. So the Clek Liing fit is manufacturer-confirmed, corroborating Clek's official list.

install.pieces: pair (left + right adapters that click onto the Dragonfly frame; infant car seat then clicks into the adapters)
install.notes: Bugaboo 'click-and-go' style mount, no tools; quick to move seat from car to stroller.

notes: Bundled free with the stroller — Bugaboo includes the Maxi-Cosi car seat adapters in the Dragonfly box; not sold as a standalone part number on Clek's official list ('Included with stroller'), hence partNumber null. VERIFIED CLEK-LIING FIT: Bugaboo's own Dragonfly Maxi-Cosi adapter page explicitly lists the Clek Liing among compatible seats, so the Liing rides on this Maxi-Cosi-footprint adapter and the fit is manufacturer-confirmed. For replacement/extra units, Bugaboo sells the same adapter standalone as SKU 400003001 (~$69.95; shown out of stock on Bugaboo DTC but in stock at Strolleria $69.95). Installs tool-free as a click-and-go pair. Image reuses the standalone-adapter product photo (the included adapter is the identical part).
